note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928), originally in English; only the soldier is given with characters and measurements, and neither the worker nor the alate is described for this species; synonymy, figure numbers, localities and Kohl’s nesting observations are not translated; the original also points out that the small soldier recorded by Sjöstedt is in fact a Microtermes.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head hairy and setose, yellow; the sides slightly rounded, slightly narrowed anteriorly; antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 sometimes showing traces of division, segment 2 usually almost as long as segments 3 and 4 together; gula very wide; labrum long, apex rounded; fontanelle indistinct; anterior margin of the pronotum notched. Measurements (mm): head length 1.83, head width 1.05, pronotal length 0.50, width 0.83, hind tibia length 0.90, left mandible length 0.63. Distinctly larger than P. prorepens, the head proportionally wider and hairy and setose; the specimens agree with Sjöstedt’s syntypes.
